description: This PHP class 'CommunicationTransformer' is part of the Goteo package and transforms a communication model by extracting various properties such as subject, template, type, language, filter, image, success status, and available actions.

classes.name: CommunicationTransformer
classes.description: Transforms a communication model into an array of its properties for serialization or presentation, including subject, template, type, languages, filter, image, success status, and actions.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the communication model.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns a textual label based on the template type (newsletter or general communication).

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the communication model.

methods.name: getLang
methods.description: Returns an array of available languages for the communication.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter associated with the communication.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the URL link to the header image if the template is a newsletter.

methods.name: getSuccess
methods.description: Returns an HTML span element representing the success status as a percentage with color styling.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of URLs for actions like edit, preview, clone, and details, depending on the model's state.
